/** Adds two numbers, and every test covers it. */
export function add(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a + b;
}

/** Shells out to a foreign toolchain, so no unit test runs it. */
// [lydite:exclude_from_coverage][it invokes a foreign toolchain; the proving
// ground exercises it]
export function provision(name: string): string {
  let out = "";
  if (name === "") {
    out += "anonymous";
  } else {
    out += name;
  }
  out += "-provisioned";
  return out;
}

/** Holds an arrow function, whose lines belong to the function declaring it. */
export function tally(items: number[]): number {
  const double = (n: number) => {
    return n * 2;
  };
  return items.map(double).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
}

/** A counter whose methods share one class body. */
export class Counter {
  private value = 0;

  /** Adds one. */
  bump(): void {
    this.value += 1;
  }

  /** Never called by any test. */
  // [lydite:exclude_from_coverage][the value is read only by the worker]
  read(): number {
    return this.value;
  }
}
